functional.quote: The reactant and product geometries used in the NEB calculation were optimized at the B3LYP/cc-pVTZ level, with the optimized structures provided in the Supplementary Information.

basis.quote: All calculations used Dunning’s cc-pVXZ basis set, with density-fitted integrals in Cholesky-decomposed form.

software.quote: All HF, DFT calculations and required integrals were obtained using PySCF,<sup>52</sup> and the AFQMC code is available in a public repository.<sup>53</sup>
